volume_or_chapter: 卷01 武帝紀(曹操)
locator: paragraph assessing 袁紹 before the campaign
excerpt_zh: 吾知紹之爲人，志大而智小，色厲而膽薄，忌克而少威，兵多而分畫不明，將驕而政令不一，土地雖廣，糧食雖豐，適足以爲吾奉也。
ambiguity_note: 曹操's own stated basis for confidence before the campaign, quoted in his own annals.

volume_or_chapter: 卷01 武帝紀(曹操)
locator: paragraph on the 白馬 relief, 顏良's death
excerpt_zh: 使張遼、關羽前登，擊破，斬良。
ambiguity_note: Credit for 顏良's death is shared with 張遼 (not a separately scored person in this slice) in 曹操's own annals -- contrast with the ROMANCE version (RM-C025-P2), which credits 關羽 alone.

volume_or_chapter: 卷01 武帝紀(曹操)
locator: paragraph on 荀彧's letter urging 曹操 to hold the Guandu line
excerpt_zh: 紹悉衆聚官渡，欲與公決勝敗。公以至弱當至彊，若不能制，必爲所乘，是天下之大機也。
ambiguity_note: 曹操 wanted to withdraw to 許 when supplies ran low; 荀彧's letter persuaded him to hold, and 公從之 immediately follows in the source.

volume_or_chapter: 卷01 武帝紀(曹操)
locator: paragraph on 許攸's defection
excerpt_zh: 紹謀臣許攸貪財，紹不能足，來奔，因說公擊瓊等。
ambiguity_note: This account attributes the defection to 袁紹's stinginess toward 許攸; compare HB-J10-P2, a different HISTORY_BASE biography (荀彧傳) attributing it instead to 審配 arresting 許攸's family for lawbreaking -- two passages within the same work disagree on the proximate cause, not flagged by any annotation, so recorded here rather than coded as source_conflict_note (that label is reserved for cases an annotation itself flags).

volume_or_chapter: 卷01 武帝紀(曹操)
locator: paragraph on 張郃/高覽's defection after the Wuchao raid
excerpt_zh: 紹遣騎救瓊。左右或言「賊騎稍近，請分兵拒之」。公怒曰：「賊在背後，乃白！」士卒皆殊死戰，大破瓊等，皆斬之。紹初聞公之擊瓊，謂長子譚曰：「就彼攻瓊等，吾攻拔其營，彼固無所歸矣！」乃使張郃、高覽攻曹洪。郃等聞瓊破，遂來降。
ambiguity_note: This account (武帝紀) frames the defection as opportunistic, immediately after hearing Wuchao had fallen. Compare 張郃's own biography (HB-J17-P2), which gives a different proximate cause (fear of 郭圖's slander) -- flagged explicitly by 裴松之 as a real discrepancy (HA-J17-P1).

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹)
locator: paragraph on 沮授's initial strategic advice to 袁紹
excerpt_zh: 橫大河之北，合四州之地，收英雄之才，擁百萬之衆，迎大駕於西京，復宗廟於洛邑，號令天下，以討未復，以此爭鋒，誰能敵之？
ambiguity_note: 紹喜曰：「此吾心也」follows immediately -- unlike 沮授's later advice (HB-J06-P3/P4), this one WAS accepted, showing his advice was not rejected on principle.

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹)
locator: paragraph on 沮授 opposing dividing territory among 袁紹's sons
excerpt_zh: 出長子譚爲青州，沮授諫紹：「必爲禍始。」紹不聽，曰：「孤欲令諸兒各據一州也。」

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹)
locator: paragraph on 沮授 opposing the grain-convoy's lack of a covering force
excerpt_zh: 沮授說紹：「可遣將蔣奇別爲支軍於表，以斷曹公之鈔。」紹復不從。
ambiguity_note: This specific rejected warning -- protect the grain convoy with a covering force -- directly predicts the Wuchao disaster that follows a few sentences later in the same juan.

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹)
locator: paragraph on 沮授's capture and death
excerpt_zh: 沮授不及紹渡，爲人所執，詣太祖，太祖厚待之。後謀還袁氏，見殺。
ambiguity_note: 曹操 (the captor) treated him well, but 沮授 still tried to return to his former lord's side and was killed for it -- personal loyalty to the losing side chosen over accepting the victor's favorable treatment.

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹)
locator: paragraph on 袁紹 executing 田豐 after the defeat
excerpt_zh: 紹還，謂左右曰：「吾不用田豐言，果爲所笑。」遂殺之。
ambiguity_note: 田豐 had advised a war-of-attrition strategy instead of open battle (not separately excerpted here) and was imprisoned for insisting; he is executed specifically because the defeat proved him right, not for a new offense.

volume_or_chapter: 卷10 荀彧荀攸賈詡傳(荀彧)
locator: paragraph: 荀彧's character assessment of 袁紹's staff
excerpt_zh: 紹兵雖多而法不整。田豐剛而犯上，許攸貪而不治。審配專而無謀，逢紀果而自用，此二人留知後事，若攸家犯其法，必不能縱也，不縱，攸必爲變。顏良、文醜，一夫之勇耳，可一戰而禽也。
ambiguity_note: This assessment correctly predicts 許攸's defection over a legal matter involving his family -- compare HB-J01-P4's different account of the same defection's cause.

volume_or_chapter: 卷10 荀彧荀攸賈詡傳(荀彧)
locator: paragraph confirming 審配 arrested 許攸's family, triggering his defection
excerpt_zh: 審配以許攸家不法，收其妻子，攸怒叛紹；顏良、文醜臨陣授首；田豐以諫見誅：皆如彧所策。
ambiguity_note: Same defection as HB-J01-P4, different proximate cause given (family's arrest, not stinginess) -- two HISTORY_BASE biographies disagree; no annotation flags this one, so not coded source_conflict_note.

volume_or_chapter: 卷14 程昱郭嘉董昭劉曄蔣濟劉放傳(郭嘉)
locator: paragraph: 郭嘉's character assessment of 袁紹 (reason he left 袁紹's service)
excerpt_zh: 袁公徒欲效周公之下士，而未知用人之機。多端寡要，好謀無決，欲與共濟天下大難，定霸王之業，難矣！
ambiguity_note: 郭嘉 himself formerly served 袁紹 before leaving to join 曹操 -- this is his stated reason, predating the campaign itself.

volume_or_chapter: 卷17 張樂于張徐傳(張郃)
locator: paragraph: 張郃 correctly advises saving the Wuchao grain, is overruled
excerpt_zh: 郃説紹曰：「曹公兵精，往必破瓊等；瓊等破，則將軍事去矣，宜急引兵救之。」郭圖曰：「郃計非也。不如攻其本營，勢必還，此爲不救而自解也。」
ambiguity_note: 袁紹 sides with 郭圖's counter-proposal over 張郃's, sending only light cavalry to Wuchao while committing the main force to attack 曹操's main camp instead -- the attack fails and Wuchao falls anyway.

volume_or_chapter: 卷17 張樂于張徐傳(張郃)
locator: paragraph: 張郃 defects after 郭圖 falsely blames him
excerpt_zh: 圖慚，又更譖郃曰：「郃快軍敗，出言不遜。」郃懼，乃歸太祖。
ambiguity_note: 張郃's own biography gives fear of 郭圖's slander as the cause -- a different account from 武帝紀's framing (HB-J01-P5), explicitly flagged as a discrepancy by 裴松之 (HA-J17-P1).

volume_or_chapter: 卷01 武帝紀(曹操) annotation block
locator: paragraph inside 〈〉 bracket, 曹瞞傳 quoting 許攸's Wuchao proposal
excerpt_zh: 今袁氏輜重有萬餘乘，在故市、烏巢，屯軍無嚴備；今以輕兵襲之，不意而至，燔其積聚，不過三日，袁氏自敗也。
ambiguity_note: 曹操 acts on this immediately per the surrounding narrative -- the single most consequential proposal of the whole campaign.

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹) annotation block
locator: paragraph inside 〈〉 bracket, 沮授's last words before being killed
excerpt_zh: 冀州失策，以取奔北。授智力俱困，宜其見禽耳。
ambiguity_note: 沮授's own words to 曹操 after capture, acknowledging the side he served lost through its own strategic failure -- not blaming external factors.

volume_or_chapter: 卷06 董二袁劉傳(袁紹) annotation block
locator: paragraph inside 〈〉 bracket, 曹操 predicting 袁紹's defeat from hearing 田豐 was sidelined
excerpt_zh: 太祖聞豐不從戎，喜曰：「紹必敗矣。」
ambiguity_note: 曹操 treats 袁紹's own treatment of a correct dissenting advisor as itself predictive of the campaign's outcome.

volume_or_chapter: 卷17 張樂于張徐傳(張郃) annotation block
locator: paragraph inside 〈〉 bracket, 裴松之 flagging a discrepancy between two accounts of 張郃's defection
excerpt_zh: 臣松之案武紀及袁紹傳幷云袁紹使張郃、高覽攻太祖營，郃等聞淳于瓊破，遂來降，紹衆於是大潰。是則緣郃等降而後紹軍壞也。至如此傳，爲紹軍先潰，懼郭圖之譖，然後歸太祖，爲參錯不同矣。
ambiguity_note: 裴松之 himself explicitly names the discrepancy between 武帝紀/袁紹傳's account (HB-J01-P5) and 張郃's own biography (HB-J17-P2) -- a textbook source_conflict_note case.

volume_or_chapter: 第二十五回
locator: paragraph on 關羽 killing 顏良
excerpt_zh: 關公奮然上馬，倒提青龍刀，跑下山來，鳳目圓睜，蠶眉直豎，直衝彼陣，河北軍如波開浪裂。關公逕奔顏良。顏良正在麾蓋下，見關公衝來，方欲問時，關公赤兔馬快，早已跑到面前。顏良措手不及，被雲長手起一刀，刺於馬下。
ambiguity_note: Contrast with HB-J01-P2: ROMANCE gives 關羽 sole, personal credit with a full combat set-piece; HISTORY_BASE credits 張遼 and 關羽 jointly in one plain sentence.

volume_or_chapter: 第二十六回
locator: paragraph on 關羽 killing 文醜
excerpt_zh: 文醜回馬復來，徐晃急輪大斧，截住廝殺。只見文醜後面軍馬齊到，晃料敵不過，撥馬而回。文醜沿河趕來...與文醜交馬，戰不三合，文醜心怯，撥馬遶河而走。關公馬快，趕上文醜，腦後一刀，將文醜斬下馬來。

volume_or_chapter: 第二十六回
locator: paragraph on 沮授 opposing crossing the river to pursue
excerpt_zh: 沮授曰：「不可。今宜留屯延津，分兵官渡，乃爲上策。若輕舉渡河，設或有變，眾皆不能還矣。」紹怒曰：「皆是汝等遲緩軍心，遷延日月，有妨大事！豈不聞『兵貴神速』乎？」
ambiguity_note: Near-identical in substance to the HISTORY_ANNOTATION account of this same warning (compatible divergence, not separately excerpted here) -- one of the few places ROMANCE closely tracks the historical source rather than embellishing it.

volume_or_chapter: 第三十回
locator: paragraph on 田豐 warning from prison before the march
excerpt_zh: 田豐從獄中上書諫曰：「今且宜靜守以待天時，不可妄興大兵，恐有不利。」逢紀譖曰：「主公興仁義之師，田豐何得出此不祥之語？」

volume_or_chapter: 第三十回
locator: paragraph on 袁紹 imprisoning 沮授 alongside 田豐
excerpt_zh: 紹怒曰：「田豐慢我軍心，吾回日必斬之。汝安敢又如此！」叱左右將沮授鎖禁軍中。「待我破曹之後，與田豐一體治罪！」
ambiguity_note: Contradictory divergence: HISTORY_BASE (HB-J06-P4) has 沮授 stripped of part of his command but not imprisoned before the battle -- he is only captured later, during the retreat. ROMANCE has him explicitly imprisoned alongside 田豐 before the battle even starts, a stronger claim than the historical record supports.

volume_or_chapter: 第二十二回
locator: paragraph: 荀彧's character assessment of 袁紹's staff (dialogue with 孔融)
excerpt_zh: 紹兵多而不整。田豐剛而犯上，許攸貪而不智，審配專而無謀，逢紀果而無用。此數人者，勢不相容，必生內變。顏良、文醜，匹夫之勇，一戰可擒。其餘碌碌等輩，縱有百萬，何足道哉！
ambiguity_note: Compatible divergence: near-identical in substance to HB-J10-P1, the same passage from 荀彧's own HISTORY_BASE biography -- ROMANCE stages it as spoken dialogue with 孔融 rather than a memorial to 曹操, but the assessment's content is essentially unchanged.
